chapter.verse: No gam ukte aw, a manin thu na khen uh hiam? Note in mi khempeuh thu a tangin na khen uh hiam?
Hi peuhmah lo hi, na lungsim uh ah aman lo na ngaihsun uh a, gam sungah ngongtatna na gamta uh hi.
Migilote, a khan’ tawntungin khial uh hi, a suah tung mah-un lam khial pah uh a, zuauthu gen uh hi.
Amaute in gulpi’ gu bang gu nei uh a, a khiimte’ aw ahi zongin, a zol siamte’ aw ahi zongin a za lo, gul bengngong tawh kibang uh hi.
Pasian aw, amau kam sunga hate sutan in la, humpinelkai khanglai hatute botkhia in, Topa aw.
Tui luangkhiate bangin amaute mangthangsak in la, lopa bangin amaute kituancil-in keutumsak in.
Amaute, a naai a bei toktol, a hun cing loin a nausuak, ni a mu ngei lote bangsak in.
Na beelte in lingkung kuang pen sa a sak ma-in, a hing a keu-in amah in tuate phiatkhia mang hen!
Heh thukna a muh ciangin thuman mipa lungdam ding a, migilote’ si sungah amah in a khete sil ding hi.
Mite in, “Thuman mi’ ading noptuamna om taktak a, leitunga thukhen Pasian khat om taktak hi,” ci ding uh hi.
